title: Improvement idea
body: Would be nice if we could see an overview of all things on one page. Such as: on one screen one can see today, upcoming events, events scheduled for the week, coming months and even undated todos all in one view for overall perspective. A month calender view would also be nice. Setting calendar events with reminders the day before or on other days and even time for a calendar  event would be nice. I hate how I have to use calendar app separately to get this feature. Paid for both the mobile app and macOS and slightly disappointed considering the review and rating of this app on the AppStore. There’s potential to be much better.

It was still worth it tho to me!

title: Great app, but...
body:
Coming from Ticktick I found this app easier and more straightforward to use. I also prefer a one-time purchase rather than the subscription model. 

I came for the way the app keeps track of day/evening tasks but also the "some time" category for saving stuff til later. 

Following the tutorial made the app crash a couple of times. I don't know if that will happen to me once I start working on bigger projects. We'll see.

title: Defer
body: Would be great to be able to set a specific time for a task and have it not show up in today until that specified time. Maybe a toggle setting to be able to have it work like this?
author: nejin

title: Good app, missing encryption/privacy
body:
Great UI and overall a well-designed app. 

But it doesn’t provide privacy when syncing across devices, like Apple does for e.g. Apple Home. 

I wish they would add end-to-end encryption for the todo content. Hopefully in the next major update.
author: Alex.1789

title: Riktigt bra

title: Can’t live without it
body:
It’s functionality is limited compared to others to-do apps, but the detailed thinking of how people use it, the workflow and how well thought through things are make it my preferred choice.

My only complaint is I still have to go to Asana when it comes to collaborative projects. I wish there was a way to handle shared to-dos with Things: assigning home tasks to family members, assigning certain tasks to someone… etc.

Besides that, as an individual to-so app. It’s perfect.

author: Opdahl

title: Superb task manager
body:
Things 3 is the best task manager I’ve come across. It’s helping me get more productive and effective at studying, cleaning, et.c. 

But a few things could be added or changed as a bonus:

Better calendar integration, maybe to be able to either create new events or to create reminders based on events;
File tagging, to be able to put images, PDF's, et.c. as attachments in the reminders; and
Better Workflow automation / Better Things URL automation, I’d really like to see more automation, ex:
To be able to create and organize a reminder from workflow, or
To be able to delete reminders

But, as I said, those are only bonuses that would make the app better and easier to use. Still, Things 3 deserves 5 stars; it’s simple, clean and effective.

title: Poor design for Apple Watch
body: Poor design for Apple Watch. You can only see today’s tasks on the watch. If you complete a task or move it to some other day, perhaps by mistake, you can’t change that on the watch so you need to get your phone. I’ve used the app for a couple of days now and the watch app sometimes freezes up.

body:

body:
